motors.catalogueStatus: NRND; motor-sized reference, not purchasing recommendation

motors.architecture: three-phase iron-wound brushless, Hall sensors, four pole pairs
motors.role: source-bound future low-inertia option; not executed adopted plant
motors.currentConvention: Catalogue block current in each commutation interval; Kt gives average block torque; R/L are phase-to-phase

linkedCatalogueDifferences.selection: Use live-page values consistently; do not mix revisions

recommendation: Use adequately sized RE35 terminal-DC motor for adopted SEA diagnostic. Keep explicit independent rotor/nut states. EC-i30 is an unexecuted future option; RE25 is an undersized historical comparator.

drive.peakStatus: 3.5A is an assumed bounded driver limit, not motor continuous rating or established allowable peak duration
drive.responseStatus: Servo target subject to computed L*di/dt voltage clipping and installed measurement; not passive L/R
drive.hotResistanceIfUsed: Rhot=R25*(1+0.0039*100) is an assumed100C temperature rise, not a measured hot rating
drive.heating: Report measured model RMS current and copper loss separately from short transient force passes; continuous torque/current ratings do not validate this mounting/cooling
drive.inductance: Catalogue stationary1kHz measurement. Manufacturer says effective PWM inductance may be30–80percent of catalogue. Use catalogueL as a declared slew assumption, not identified driver phase response
drive.ecCaveat: EC catalogue constants/current apply to average block commutation. Supply current and FOC sinusoidal phase amplitude differ; no ripple/cogging/commutation model is established by the equivalent DC equations

screw.transmission: Efficient reversible ball-screw reference with no gearbox; generic sliding/trapezoidal leadscrew needs a separately identified loss/self-locking model
screw.efficiencyRole: 90percent is static sizing only, supported by THK ball-screw FAQ. Native dynamics should use reversible pitch mapping and explicit passive torque/guide loss, not a sign-independent efficiency multiplier

geometrySanity.status: Order-of-magnitude check, not purchased screw inertia; actual root/journals/length/coupling change it

screw.carriageStatus: Explicit added translating mass, not measured. Do not hide it in B or add rotary inertia to B
screw.bearings: Use dedicated axial screw-support/thrust bearings; small motor-shaft axial ratings are below50N
screw.losses: No-load current at high catalog speed identifies combined loss only. Coulomb/viscous/stiction split at our lower speed remains an engineering assumption pending identification
screw.bodyMass: Motor belongs in A. Matched A=1.5kg must include stated motor and remaining mount/ballast, not silently assume screw has same body mass as coil

pad.mechanicalPropertyStatus: Whole-pad equivalent k/c sweep is representative engineering sensitivity, NOT measured Mirka stiffness/damping. Reviewed manufacturer pages list geometry/use, no dynamic k/c

materialPlausibility.material: PORON4701-30 Very Soft,240kg/m3 nominal density grade; not Mirka pad material
materialPlausibility.conversion: k_secant = manufacturer bulk compression stress * assumed disk area / (compression fraction * assumed thickness)
materialPlausibility.limits: Quasistatic bulk-material plausibility only, not tangent/dynamic stiffness, manufacturer sanding-pad specification, local-pressure analysis or a guarantee across amplitude/frequency

nonlinearityExample.status: Different thin battery-pad construction; illustrative material nonlinearity, not exact5/10mm sanding pad
nonlinearityExample.limits: Datasheet typical values are not specification limits; no dynamic damping coefficient is identified

pad.damping: Every nonzero c remains unvalidated material sensitivity; c=0 is a lossless counterfactual. Fit installed frequency/amplitude-dependent response before prototype claims
pad.compressionGuard: Stop/flag validity beyond50percent thickness. A positive force from extrapolated linear elasticity is not a valid pad beyond its declared working range
pad.footprint: Sum only compressive local-contact contributions before reporting total axial force. Clipping an already averaged height is not equivalent in partial contact. Do not publish local-pressure scores
pad.causality: Plant surface truth is unavailable to controller; controller inputs are acquired force, S acceleration, relative position and already-issued robot commands
omissions: Holes, hook-and-loop, abrasive and local workpiece compliance
Pad orbit/spin, distributed inertia and flexural modes
Unknown sanding drag deferred by prototype scope

internalSEASprings.purpose: Opposed pair free-length/force bookkeeping only; not a qualified coil-spring design
internalSEASprings.verification: Check actual solid height, wire/diameter/turn count, stress/fatigue, buckling guidance, seats and frame flexibility.50mm free and8mm minimum do not establish manufacturability at these loads
internalSEASprings.topology: Internal nut-to-B spring, not prescribed R-A upper spring or external B-S connection; rotor inertia acts at independent nut coordinate
